examples.english: When they fume, they lose control and start yelling at people.
examples.traditional: 佢一有火氣就控制唔到自己，周圍鬧人。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 jau5 fo2 hei3 zau6 hung3 zai3 m4 dou3 zi6 gei2 zau1 wai4 naau6 jan2

examples.english: Their anger is so high today that they snap at everyone over the slightest thing.
examples.traditional: 佢今日火氣好大，少少事都鬧人。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 fo2 hei3 hou2 daai6 siu2 siu2 si6 dou1 naau6 jan4

examples.english: Cool your temper first; don't yell so loudly.
examples.traditional: 你收吓火氣先，唔好咁大聲鬧人。
examples.jyutping: nei5 sau1 haa5 fo2 hei3 sin1 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1 naau6 jan4

examples.english: You don’t need to come in with so much fire; let’s talk it out.
examples.traditional: 你唔使咁大火氣，有嘢慢慢講。
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 daai6 fo2 hei3 jau5 je5 maan6 maan6 gong2
